counter.name: counter
counter.purpose: a count with a floor of zero; the minimum model with state and a lifecycle

widget.name: widget
widget.purpose: a thing that receives device frames; the host for every topic-handler exemplar

document.name: document
document.purpose: the codex document on Studio: owns the notes served by /api/codex/objects; host for every service-request exemplar

user.name: user
user.purpose: a member of a team; the child model in every container exemplar, parent-aware so it can reach its team

team.name: team
team.purpose: a team that owns its users in place; host for the container exemplars

note.name: note
note.purpose: one Studio codex object (id + desc); the child of document in the service-mapping and container-capacity exemplars

project.name: project
project.purpose: a project that depends on other models and owns a capped collection of tasks; host for the model-dependencies and container-capacity exemplars

task.name: task
task.purpose: a long-running piece of work on Studio; host for the futures and multi-futures exemplars

session.name: session
session.purpose: a user session with an explicit lifecycle; host for the state-machine, state-properties, companion and troubles exemplars

device.name: device
device.purpose: stands in for the device: publishes frames and out-of-band object changes through the codex backend's test endpoints

journal.name: journal
journal.purpose: a list of notes whose baseline read races its own delta, for the topic catch-up exemplar
